title: Recently discovered 10,000-year-old ancient city in Texas

tellings.quote: There's a there's a there's an ancient city in Texas that was discovered recently that's 10,000 years old next to this river.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, says an ancient city was recently found in Texas next to a river. He says it is about 10,000 years old, though he does not name the place. If so, it would push organised settlement in North America far further back than usually thought.
